_doc: Cases that do not belong to one block directory: entries with their own "path" (core's fixture block) and cross-block chains. Each block's own cases live in blocks/<name>/e2e.json (same shape: cases, conflicts, chains), which install.test.mjs reads and merges with this file (by case name; the block's file wins). Every block runs once with default params with no entry at all. registryDependencies are installed by `kit install` itself (--blocks-dir blocks/); "dependencyParams": {"cf-email-sender": {"mailer": "console"}} becomes --param cf-email-sender.mailer=console.
